258.title: 玉斧
258.evidence: a jade axe head would have been tied to a wooden shaft and held by a chieftain as a symbol of authority.
258.note: 名称与材料据原表保留的馆方描述补充；不据外观推测工艺。

259.title: 玉琮
259.evidence: a ‘cong’ is a jade cylinder that is square on the outside with a round perforation in the middle.
259.note: 名称与材料据原表保留的馆方描述补充；不据外观推测工艺。
